items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Freddie Keppert. And Louis Keppert. This... Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: Freddie Keppert used to go riding on the trucks. They'd have a truck. They'd go riding on the band. They'd play on different corners. Freddie Keppert. And Louis Keppert. This... Joe Oliver. Oh, yeah. Kid Rene. And Buddy P.T.
